columns.name: ssObjectId
columns.description: Id of the solar system object this source was associated with, if any.

columns.name: ra
columns.description: Right ascension coordinate of the center of this diaSource.

columns.name: dec
columns.description: Declination coordinate of the center of this diaSource.

columns.name: midpointMjdTai
columns.description: Effective mid-visit time for this diaSource, TAI MJD.

columns.name: band
columns.description: Filter band this source was observed with.

columns.name: psfFluxErr
columns.description: Flux uncertainty for Point Source model.

columns.name: snr
columns.description: Signal-to-noise ratio of the PSF flux.

columns.name: trailLength
columns.description: Length of the trail, when trailed.

columns.name: isDipole
columns.description: Source well fit by a dipole.
